lines: A sugar cube of this star weighs one billion tons.
A SUGAR CUBE of this star weighs 1 BILLION TONS.
One billion tons? That's not a sugar cube, that's a cheat day!
1 BILLION TONS? That's not a SUGAR CUBE, that's a CHEAT DAY!
[laughs] Buzzers ready! [excited] It's Planet Reviews, and today's guest is a neutron star. Real or fake?
BUZZERS READY! It's PLANET REVIEWS, and today's guest is a NEUTRON STAR. REAL or FAKE?
Claim one. She's heavier than our Sun, but only about twelve miles across. The size of a city.
CLAIM #1. She's HEAVIER than our SUN, but only about 12 MILES across. The size of a CITY.
Fake. Nobody fits a whole Sun into a city. I can't even fit my couch in my apartment.
FAKE. Nobody fits a whole SUN into a CITY. I can't even fit my COUCH in my APARTMENT.
Real! Squished down to about the size of Manhattan.
REAL! Squished down to about the size of MANHATTAN.
Claim two. The fastest one spins forty-three thousand times a minute.
CLAIM #2. The FASTEST one spins 43,000 TIMES A MINUTE.
Okay, that's fake. That's faster than my blender.
Okay, that's FAKE. That's faster than my BLENDER.
Real! Twice as fast as your blender. She's basically a smoothie with a pulse.
REAL! TWICE as fast as your BLENDER. She's basically a SMOOTHIE with a PULSE.
Claim three. Her magnetic field is trillions of times stronger than Earth's.
CLAIM #3. Her MAGNETIC FIELD is TRILLIONS of times stronger than EARTH'S.
Fine. Real. Keep her away from my credit cards.
Fine. REAL. Keep her away from my CREDIT CARDS.
And a magnetar, her angry cousin, is another thousand times stronger.
And a MAGNETAR, her ANGRY COUSIN, is another 1,000 TIMES stronger.
Final claim. When astronomers first caught her blinking in nineteen sixty-seven, they nicknamed the signal little green men.
FINAL CLAIM. When astronomers first caught her BLINKING in 1967, they nicknamed the signal LITTLE GREEN MEN.
Real. Final rating: ten out of ten for drama. Zero out of ten as a sweetener.
REAL. FINAL RATING: 10/10 for DRAMA. 0/10 as a SWEETENER.
Tomorrow on Planet Reviews: the planet whose clouds smell like rotten eggs. Follow so you don't miss it!
TOMORROW on PLANET REVIEWS: the planet whose CLOUDS smell like ROTTEN EGGS. FOLLOW so you don't miss it!
Still lighter than one sugar cube of her.
Still LIGHTER than one SUGAR CUBE of her.
